message_en:
NAVAREA XIX 124/26
These are the NAVAREA XIX warnings in force at 091418 UTC on October 26.
2026 series: 114, 122, 123, 124.
NAVAREA XIX 121/26 is cancelled.

NAVAREA XIX 114/261. The Norwegian government has decided that Russian fishing vessels are only allowed to enter three ports on the Norwegian mainland:
A. Båtsfjord (NOBJF)
B. Kirkenes (NOKKN)
C. Tromsø (NOTOS)
Entry to all other ports on the Norwegian mainland is prohibited for Russian fishing vessels from 132200 UTC October 2022. NAVAREA XIX 45/26 is cancelled.

Navarea xix 122/26
1. Riglist. Correct at 090526 utc oct 26
Norwegian sea: North of 65n, east of 5w.

72-32.44n 020-21.35e - transocean enabler
67-01.61n 005-18.19e - transocean norge
65-17.16n 007-18.05e - island innovator
65-07.08n 006-40.31e - transocean encourage

Notes:
a. Rigs are protected by a 500 metre safety zone.
b. For rigs located south of 65n, refer to navarea i warnings or visit www.ukho.gov.uk/rnw
2. Cancel navarea xix 107/26

NAVAREA XIX 123/26
Seismic survey in progress by M/V Amazon Conqueror towing 12 cables, each 10,000 metres long, in an area bounded by positions:
A: 64°33.50'N 006°04.80'E
B: 64°32.70'N 004°33.70'E
C: 65°40.80'N 005°19.70'E
D: 65°42.20'N 006°52.30'E
Wide berth of 3 miles ahead and abeam, 7 miles astern requested. M/V Amber G and M/V Ocean Dee are in attendance.
NAVAREA XIX 106/26 is cancelled.
